name: D&D 5e
description: Fifth Edition Dungeons & Dragons - d20 System with ability scores, skills, and class-based progression

core_mechanic.success_threshold: Roll meets or beats target DC

skills.name: Arcana
skills.description: Recall lore about spells, magic items, symbols

skills.name: Deception
skills.description: Hide the truth verbally or through actions

skills.name: Insight
skills.description: Determine true intentions of a creature

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.description: Influence through threats or hostile actions

skills.name: Nature
skills.description: Recall lore about terrain, plants, animals, weather

skills.name: Performance
skills.description: Delight an audience with music, dance, or acting

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.description: Influence with tact, grace, or good nature

skills.name: Religion
skills.description: Recall lore about deities, rites, prayers

advantages.name: Alert
advantages.effect: You gain a +5 bonus to initiative. You can't be surprised while conscious.

advantages.name: Great Weapon Master
advantages.effect: On crit or reducing a creature to 0 HP with a melee weapon, make one extra melee attack as a bonus action. You can choose to take a -5 penalty to attack roll to add +10 to damage.

conditions.name: Blinded
mechanical_effects: Attacks have disadvantage; attacks against you have advantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
mechanical_effects: Charmer has advantage on social checks against you.
conditions.ends_when: effect expires or charmer harms you

conditions.name: Frightened
mechanical_effects: Disadvantage on checks and attacks while you can see the source of fear.
conditions.ends_when: effect expires or you can't see the source

conditions.name: Grappled
mechanical_effects: Ends if grappler is incapacitated or effect removes you.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.trigger: HP drops to 0 or specific effect
conditions.ends_when: HP restored above 0 or effect ends

conditions.name: Poisoned
mechanical_effects: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
conditions.ends_when: poison duration expires or is cured

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.trigger: knocked down or drop to 0 HP
mechanical_effects: Melee attacks against you have advantage; ranged attacks have disadvantage.
conditions.ends_when: spend half movement to stand up

action_economy.turn_structure: Each creature takes one turn per round in initiative order.
action_economy.surprise_rules: Creatures that fail to notice enemies are surprised and can't act or react on first turn.

resolution_mechanics.difficulty_model: DC set by GM or table
resolution_mechanics.difficulty_range: trivial: 5, easy: 10, medium: 15, hard: 20, very_hard: 25, nearly_impossible: 30
resolution_mechanics.critical_success: Natural 20 is not an automatic success on ability checks (only on attacks), but many tables play it that way.
resolution_mechanics.critical_failure: Natural 1 is not an automatic failure on ability checks, but many tables play it that way.

resolution_mechanics.critical_success: Natural 20 always hits and doubles damage dice.

steps.title: Choose Race/Species
steps.instructions: Pick a race (Human, Elf, Dwarf, Halfling, etc.) which determines your base attributes, speed, and racial traits.

steps.title: Choose Class
steps.instructions: Pick a class (Fighter, Wizard, Rogue, Cleric, etc.) which determines your hit die, proficiencies, and class features.

steps.title: Generate Ability Scores
steps.instructions: Roll 4d6 and keep the highest 3 for each ability, then assign to STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA.

steps.title: Choose Background
steps.instructions: Pick a background (Soldier, Sage, Criminal, etc.) for additional skill proficiencies and a feature.

steps.title: Choose Skill Proficiencies
steps.instructions: Pick skills from your class and background lists. You gain proficiency in a number of skills determined by your class.

steps.title: Choose Equipment
steps.instructions: Select starting equipment from your class and background packages.

steps.title: Calculate Derived Stats
steps.instructions: Calculate HP = hit_die + CON modifier. AC = 10 + DEX modifier + armor. Initiative = DEX modifier.

steps.title: Write Backstory
steps.instructions: Describe your character's personality, ideals, bonds, and flaws.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.feature_description: You still have rank from your military service.

backgrounds.name: Sage
backgrounds.description: You spent years learning from scholars.
backgrounds.feature_description: You know where to find information.

backgrounds.name: Criminal
backgrounds.feature_description: You have a contact who can smuggle items or information.

advancement.milestone_description: GM may award level ups at story milestones

name: Fate Core
description: Fate Core System - narrative-focused with aspects, fate points, and Fudge dice

core_mechanic.success_threshold: Roll meets or beats difficulty (0-8 ladder)

name: Powered by the Apocalypse
description: PbtA framework - 2d6+stat with partial success mechanics and fictional positioning

name: Narrative Pure
description: Pure fiction-first play. Players describe intent, the GM answers with consequences, and the story moves without dice unless the table explicitly wants an oracle.

core_mechanic.formula: No roll — resolve by fiction, stakes, and consequences
core_mechanic.success_threshold: If the action fits the fiction, it happens; if it is risky, the GM answers with a cost, complication, or hard choice
core_mechanic.critical_success: A particularly strong fictional setup earns extra momentum or a clean advantage

oracle.description: Optional yes/no oracle if the table wants outside pressure

outcomes.yes_and: Yes, and the fiction tilts strongly in the player's favor
outcomes.yes_but: Yes, but a cost or complication follows
outcomes.no_but: No, but there is an opening or consolation

rules.name: Fiction First
rules.description: Players state what they do in the fiction. If nothing meaningfully opposes them, it simply happens. If there is danger, uncertainty, or cost, the GM responds with a consequence instead of asking for a roll.

rules.name: Consequences Drive Play
rules.description: Failure is not a dead stop. The GM advances the fiction with harm, exposure, delay, lost resources, or a worse bargain.

steps.title: Name your concept
steps.instructions: Describe who you are, what you want, and what usually gets you into trouble.

steps.title: Anchor the character
steps.instructions: Choose one relationship, one burden, and one promise that the GM can bring into play.

character_creation.notes: No stat rolling is required. Character identity comes from concept, relationships, and fictional positioning.

name: Narrative Weighted
description: Fiction-first play with a light d20-under check. Start from difficulty 10, then add or subtract narrative modifiers for preparation, pressure, positioning, help, and surprise.

core_mechanic.success_threshold: Base target 10; roll under or equal to the final target after narrative modifiers are applied
core_mechanic.critical_success: 1 is a strong success with extra momentum or control
core_mechanic.critical_failure: 20 is a hard complication or reversal

skills.name: Skirmish
skills.description: Fight, shove through danger, rush someone, or shoot under pressure

skills.name: Finesse
skills.description: Aim carefully, sneak, pick locks, evade, or act with precision

skills.name: Read
skills.description: Notice details, investigate, assess risk, sense danger, or understand a person

skills.name: Sway
skills.description: Convince, charm, threaten, negotiate, mislead, or command attention

rules.name: Base Difficulty 10
rules.description: Start every risky action at difficulty 10. Add the most relevant approach rating, then apply narrative modifiers for help, preparation, tools, leverage, surprise, exposure, harm, or bad footing.

rules.name: Narrative Modifiers
rules.description: Use +1/-1 for a minor edge or setback, +2/-2 for a strong one, and +3/-3 for overwhelming fictional leverage. Stack only what the fiction clearly supports.

steps.title: Assign approaches
steps.instructions: Assign +2, +1, 0, and 0 across Force, Finesse, Insight, and Presence to reflect how your character tackles problems.

steps.title: Define leverage
steps.instructions: Write down one edge, one flaw, and one contact the GM can turn into narrative modifiers during play.

character_creation.notes: Roll only when the outcome is uncertain and the fiction is under pressure. Otherwise, let the story move.

name: Death in Space
description: Sci-fi RPG about desperate freelancers in the cold void of space. TTRPG system featuring d20 roll-under, Stress & Debt mechanics, ship-to-ship combat, and mortal danger around every airlock.

attributes.name: Bravery
attributes.description: Willpower, courage, and staying calm under fire.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Running, climbing, swimming, jumping in zero-G.

skills.name: Melee
skills.description: Fighting with blades, pipes, or fists.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: First aid, surgery, and treating conditions.

skills.name: Navigation
skills.description: Plotting courses, reading star charts, piloting.

skills.name: Courage
skills.description: Resisting fear, maintaining composure under fire.

skills.name: Streetwise
skills.description: Black markets, criminal contacts, underworld knowledge.

threshold_effects.effect: Disadvantage on physical actions until healed.
You are incapacitated and will die in 3 rounds without stabilization.
You are on edge. -1 to all checks.
You are barely holding it together. -2 to all checks.
You must flee, freeze, or act irrationally.
Creditors start sending collectors.
Your assets are frozen. No legitimate work available.
Bounty hunters are actively pursuing you.
Systems failing. Life support compromised.
Hull breaches. Some systems offline.

conditions.name: Wounded
mechanical_effects: Disadvantage on physical actions until healed.

conditions.name: Stressed
mechanical_effects: Cumulative -1 to all checks per threshold reached.

conditions.name: Breaking Down
mechanical_effects: Must flee, freeze, or act irrationally for the scene.

conditions.name: Low Oxygen
conditions.trigger: Oxygen runs out or environment is vacuum
mechanical_effects: Can't hold breath more than BDY rounds.

action_economy.turn_structure: GM calls for actions when the fiction demands it. No strict initiative order — GM decides who acts based on narrative positioning.
action_economy.initiative_model: GM discretion based on fiction and positioning

resolution_mechanics.critical_success: Natural 1: exceptional success with bonus effect.
Natural 1: critical hit — double damage or called shot.
resolution_mechanics.critical_failure: Natural 20: weapon jams, friendly fire, or worse.

tiered_ability_systems.name: Crew Roles
tiered_ability_systems.acquisition_rule: Choose one primary role at creation.

tiers.name: Greenhorn
tiers.effect: +1 to role-related checks

tiers.name: Veteran
tiers.effect: +2 to role-related checks, unlock special maneuver

tiers.name: Ace
tiers.effect: +3 to role-related checks, signature move

rules.name: Roll Under Attributes
rules.description: To attempt something risky, roll 1d20 and try to get at or below the relevant attribute score. Lower is better.

rules.name: Stress & Consequences
rules.description: When you fail a check or face horrors, gain 1 Stress. At certain thresholds, penalties apply. At max Stress, you break down.

rules.name: Debt Mechanic
rules.description: Taking a loan or owing a favor increases Debt. Higher Debt means more dangerous creditors. Complete jobs to pay it off.

rules.name: Ship Combat
rules.description: Ship combat uses the same roll-under system but against the ship's stats. Hull damage reduces Ship Hull track. At 0, the ship is destroyed.

steps.title: Roll Attributes
steps.instructions: Roll 3d6 in order for BDY, DEX, INS, BRV, CHA. These are your attribute scores AND your roll-under targets.

steps.title: Choose Background
steps.instructions: Pick a background (Military, Corporate, Scavenger, Medical, Criminal, Academic) for skill bonuses.

steps.title: Choose Skills
steps.instructions: Pick 3 skills from your background list and 2 from any list. Each trained skill adds +2 to the attribute for rolls.

steps.title: Calculate Derived Stats
steps.instructions: HP = BDY score. Stress starts at 0 (max 5). Debt starts at 0 (or choose to start in debt for bonus skills).

steps.title: Define Why You're Here
steps.instructions: Write a sentence about why you're in deep space and what you owe or need.

name: Vampire: The Masquerade 5th Edition
description: Personal horror RPG where you play vampires navigating the Masquerade, Kindred politics, and the Beast within. Features dice pool mechanics, Hunger dice, Humanity degradation, and Clan-based Disciplines.

attributes.name: Stamina
attributes.description: Endurance and ability to resist damage.

attributes.name: Wits
attributes.description: Quick thinking, perception, and street smarts.

threshold_effects.effect: -2 penalty to all physical actions per level of impairment.
You enter torpor. Cannot act.
Frenzy checks are harder (+1 difficulty).
Cannot spend Willpower. Frenzy checks at +2 difficulty.
Normal humanity. You can pass as human.
Social penalty with mortals. Touchstones start to crack.
The Beast is loud. You struggle to act human. Can't use certain social skills naturally.
One more degeneration and you're gone. The hunger is everything.
You are a wight. The character is now an NPC.
Minor compulsion. Difficulty resisting feeding opportunities.
One Hunger die added to non-roused checks. Compulsion risk.
Two Hunger dice added. Compulsions become severe. Hard to resist Frenzy.
Frenzy risk on any Hunger die. Must feed immediately.

damage_types.name: Aggravated
damage_types.healing_requires: days of rest + 5 blood per level

damage_model.death_condition: Aggravated damage exceeding Health track. Final Death.
damage_model.soak_rules: Bashing is halved for vampires (round down). Lethal and Aggravated are full.
damage_model.halving_rule: Superficial damage is marked with / and halved at end of scene.

conditions.name: Mesmerized
conditions.ends_when: command fulfilled, dismissed by Dominate user, or resisted

conditions.name: Frenzy
mechanical_effects: You attack the nearest blood source or flee the provocation.
conditions.ends_when: fed, Willpower spent to resist, or scene ends

conditions.name: Rötschreck
mechanical_effects: Must flee the source at all costs.
conditions.ends_when: source removed, cornered and feed, or Willpower spent

conditions.name: Staked
conditions.trigger: wooden stake through heart while torpid
mechanical_effects: Cannot act, move, or use Disciplines.

conditions.name: Torpor
mechanical_effects: May last centuries depending on Blood Potency.
conditions.ends_when: fed blood from another vampire (or natural awakening after decades/centuries)

conditions.name: Stained
mechanical_effects: Roll Remorse at end of session — failure reduces Humanity.

conditions.name: Ghoul
conditions.trigger: fed vampire blood as a mortal
mechanical_effects: Ageless as long as you drink vampire blood monthly.

conditions.name: Compulsion
mechanical_effects: Must act on it or spend Willpower to resist.
conditions.ends_when: act on compulsion or spend Willpower

tiered_ability_systems.name: Animalism
tiered_ability_systems.description: Communication with and control over beasts. Also allows sensing the Beast in others.
tiered_ability_systems.acquisition_rule: Clan discipline for Gangrel, Nosferatu, Ravnos. Others learn at out-of-clan cost.

tiers.name: Feral Whispers
tiers.effect: Can speak with a species of animal. Social checks with them at -2 difficulty.

tiers.name: Sense the Beast
tiers.effect: Perceive if someone is vampire, ghoul, or mortal. Read emotional state.

tiers.name: Animal Succulence
tiers.effect: Animal blood satisfies as well as human blood.

tiers.name: Subsume the Spirit
tiers.effect: Enter an animal's body, controlling it while your body lies dormant.

tiers.name: Leashing the Beast
tiers.effect: Force frenzy or calm another vampire. Suppress the Beast.

tiered_ability_systems.name: Auspex
tiered_ability_systems.description: Enhanced senses, psychic perception, and ability to read auras and thoughts.
tiered_ability_systems.acquisition_rule: Clan discipline for Malkavian, Toreador, Tremere. Others at out-of-clan cost.

tiers.name: Heightened Senses
tiers.description: Sharpen one sense beyond human limits.
tiers.effect: Choose one sense. Gain +2 dice on related checks. Can see in near-darkness.

tiers.name: Aura Perception
tiers.description: See the emotional aura around living beings.
tiers.effect: Read emotional state, supernatural nature. Perception + Empathy roll.

tiers.name: The Spirit's Touch
tiers.effect: Touch an object to see its recent history and last user's emotions.

tiers.name: Telepathy
tiers.effect: Project thoughts or read minds within line of sight. Intelligence + Subterfuge vs Resolve.

tiers.name: Psychic Projection
tiers.effect: Leave your body as an astral form. Invisible to mortals. Can travel anywhere.

tiered_ability_systems.name: Dominate
tiered_ability_systems.description: Mind control through eye contact and commands. The iron fist of Kindred society.
tiered_ability_systems.acquisition_rule: Clan discipline for Lasombra, Tremere, Ventrue. Others at out-of-clan cost.

tiers.name: Compel
tiers.effect: One-word command that must be followed. Must make eye contact.

tiers.name: Mesmerize
tiers.effect: Issue a multi-step command activated by trigger condition.

tiers.name: The Forgetful Mind
tiers.effect: Rewrite memories of the target. Must hold conversation.

tiers.name: Rationalize
tiers.effect: Target rationalizes any Dominate effect placed on them. Impossible to detect.

tiers.name: Mass Manipulation
tiers.effect: Issue commands to multiple targets simultaneously.

tiered_ability_systems.name: Protean
tiered_ability_systems.description: Shapeshifting and earth melding. The classic vampire transformation discipline.
tiered_ability_systems.acquisition_rule: Clan discipline for Gangrel. Others at out-of-clan cost.

tiers.name: Eyes of the Beast
tiers.effect: Eyes glow red. Can see perfectly in any darkness.

tiers.name: Feral Weapons
tiers.effect: Grow claws (+2 damage, lethal) and fangs. Free action to activate.

tiers.name: Earth Meld
tiers.effect: Sink into natural ground for protection. Virtually undetectable.

tiers.name: Shapechange
tiers.effect: Transform into a bat, wolf, or mist. Gain animal abilities.

tiers.name: Mist Form
tiers.effect: Transform into mist. Immune to physical damage. Can seep through cracks.

tiered_ability_systems.name: Blood Sorcery
tiered_ability_systems.description: Blood magic — manipulating the vitae to create effects. Tremere specialty.
tiered_ability_systems.acquisition_rule: Clan discipline for Tremere, Banu Haqim (Assamite), Hecata. Others require special teaching.

tiers.name: Corrosive Vitae
tiers.effect: Spend blood to make your blood burn. Damage on contact.

tiers.name: Blood of Potency
tiers.effect: Boost Blood Potency for a scene. Can hold more blood and discipline bonuses.

tiers.name: Scorpion's Touch
tiers.effect: Blood becomes venomous. Mortals are paralyzed. Vampires lose blood.

tiers.name: Theft of Vitae
tiers.effect: Drain blood from a target without touching them. Line of sight.

tiers.name: Cauldron of Blood
tiers.description: Boil the blood in a target's veins.
tiers.effect: Cause Aggravated damage by boiling blood. Devastating attack.

action_economy.turn_structure: Combat turns use initiative (Dexterity + Wits). Highest acts first.
action_economy.initiative_model: Dexterity + Wits (or Dexterity + Composure for some). Roll once at start, keep for scene.

resolution_mechanics.critical_failure: Bestial Failure: Hunger die showing 1 on a failure.

resolution_mechanics.dice_formula: Attribute + Skill vs opponent's Attribute + Skill
resolution_mechanics.critical_success: Messy Critical: paired 10s with Hunger dice
resolution_mechanics.critical_failure: Bestial Failure: Hunger die 1 on failure

events.name: Feed
events.notes: Human blood reduces 1 Hunger. Draining completely reduces 2. Animal blood reduces 1 but may cause Compulsion.

events.name: Rouse Check
events.notes: Risk: Rouse check may increase Hunger by 1 on failure.

events.name: Resonance Feed
events.notes: Feeding on someone with strong emotions matching your Resonance restores extra.

rules.name: Hunger Dice
rules.description: Replace regular dice with Hunger dice equal to your current Hunger. Hunger dice showing 1 on a failure cause Bestial Failure. Paired 10s including Hunger dice cause Messy Critical.
rules.formula: hunger_dice = current_hunger, replace that many regular dice

rules.name: The Masquerade
rules.description: Vampires must hide their existence from mortals. Breaking the Masquerade is the ultimate crime in Kindred society, punished by the Blood Hunt.

rules.name: Frenzy
rules.description: When provoked by hunger, anger, or fear (fire/sunlight), roll Resolve + Composure vs difficulty. Failure = Frenzy. You lose control and the Beast acts.

rules.name: Humanity Degeneration
rules.description: Committing sins against your Humanity adds Stains. At end of session, roll Remorse (current Humanity dice). Failure = lose Humanity. At 0 = wight.
rules.formula: Remorse: roll current Humanity in dice, need at least 1 success

rules.name: Clan Bane
rules.description: Each clan has a specific weakness. Brujah frenzy easier, Malkavans have Oracle curses, Nosferatu are monstrous, Ventrue have specific feeding restrictions.

steps.title: Choose Clan
steps.instructions: Select your vampire clan (Brujah, Gangrel, Malkavian, Nosferatu, Toreador, Tremere, Ventrue, Lasombra, Banu Haqim, Hecata, Ministry, Ravnos, Salubri, Tzimisce, Caitiff). Each has unique Disciplines, bane, and compulsion.

steps.title: Assign Attributes
steps.instructions: Distribute attribute points: 1 dot in each attribute, then assign 4/3/3 across Physical/Social/Mental categories, then 2/2/1 within the favored category.

steps.title: Assign Skills
steps.instructions: Distribute 3/5/7 across three skill categories. Add 3 free specialty dots.

steps.title: Select Disciplines
steps.instructions: Choose 2 clan Disciplines at level 1 and 1 at level 2 (or distribute as preferred). Non-clan Disciplines are possible but cost more XP.

steps.title: Choose Advantages
steps.instructions: Select Backgrounds and Merits. Allocate 7 dots across Backgrounds. Choose Flaws for bonus XP.

steps.title: Calculate Derived Stats
steps.instructions: Health = Stamina + 3. Willpower = Resolve + Composure. Blood Potency starts at 1. Humanity starts at 7. Hunger starts at 1.

steps.title: Define Touchstones & Convictions
steps.instructions: Create 2-3 mortal Touchstones (people you care about) and Convictions (moral beliefs tied to them). These anchor your Humanity.

steps.title: Write Sire & Embrace
steps.instructions: Describe who Embraced you, why, and what happened to your sire. Define your Predator type (how you feed).

hunger_dice.description: Replace regular dice with Hunger dice equal to current Hunger track value.
hunger_dice.complication_on_1: Bestial Failure: The Beast interferes. Consequences occur.
hunger_dice.crit_on_10: Messy Critical when paired with another 10 (including Hunger dice): Success but at a cost.

name: Mistlands Core
description: Modular condition-weighted RPG system for the Mistlands setting.

core_mechanic.success_threshold: Roll meets or beats target DC

threshold_effects.effect: Wounded
